regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your favor of last week - April 27th - Also for your prompt response with the violin supplies, etc - and again for the beautiful roses, just in time to enhance First Friday decoration of the altars. This evening I will have been here just a week. Thanks be to God, it is quite an ideal place - to work and pray and study - and thank God, and hope - for Heaven. I think when the weather settles a little more it would be a nice trip down here - though it must be further than Detroit ....
